scripts.eas-build-pre-install: node -e "if(process.env.EAS_BUILD_PROFILE!=='production')process.exit(0);const key=process.env.EAS_BUILD_PLATFORM==='ios'?'EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_IOS_KEY':'EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_ANDROID_KEY';const missing=['EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL',key].filter(k=>!process.env[k]);if(missing.length){console.error('Defina no ambiente production do EAS: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}if(!process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL.startsWith('https://')){console.error('EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL precisa usar https em production.');process.exit(1)}"
